# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Email: security@lovelogic.ai

Do NOT open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

## Scope

- $LOVE token contract (LOVE.sol)
- AgentRegistry contract
- PnLOracle contract
- veLOVE contract
- memory-kernel package

## Response Timeline

- Acknowledgment: within 24 hours
- Initial assessment: within 72 hours
- Fix or mitigation: within 7 days (critical), 30 days (high)

## Bug Bounty

10% of slashed treasury LOVE allocated to verified vulnerability reporters.
